description: Open a URL (in the default browser), a file (in its default app) or an app by name on a desktop capsule, instead of hunting through menus. Without kind it is guessed: a path (/, ~, C:\) is a file, a scheme (https:, mailto:) or www. is a URL, anything else is an app name (a Linux menu entry such as 'Text Editor', a Windows Start menu entry such as 'Notepad', or a program on the path). Pass waitMs to wait for the new window and get it back. For web pages you will read or fill in, capsulate_browser_open is faster and more exact.

target.description: A URL, a file path or an app name

waitMs.description: Wait up to this long for the new window and return it (at most 30000)

name: capsulate_open
title: Open a URL, a file or an app
